process_items.label: Mint the ebook NFT
process_items.copy: Buy the ebook NFT for $15. The mint number received becomes the buyer's referral code.

process_items.label: Earn Through Referrals
process_items.copy: Share the mint number or referral link. Each completed referral earns an immediate, unlimited $5 commission and one ticket for the recurring $500 drawing.

process_items.label: Build Up Tickets
process_items.copy: Every completed referral automatically adds one on-chain ticket for the active $500 drawing to the holder's NFT and dashboard. More referrals mean more chances to win.

process_items.label: Enter the Prize Draw
process_items.copy: One affiliate from each 100-sales block wins $500 through provably fair Chainlink VRF selection.

process_items.label: Receive Your Rewards
process_items.copy: Commissions are delivered automatically. A $500 winner is notified on the Winners page, dashboard, and by email when available, then collects the prize through a conditional claim button shown only when the prize is eligible to be claimed.

decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete message-785 MODIFY establishing the conditional winner-initiated claim flow and removing the obsolete automatic-delivery mode.
The mission-page content does not specify direct automatic prize transfer; its general reference to automated payouts remains compatible with smart-contract payment following a claim.
The landing mechanics copy describes referral commissions, tickets, and drawing frequency but does not prescribe automatic prize delivery.
The claim-flow decision does not alter the hero's headline, CTA, layout, or visual-emphasis requirements.
Winner announcement and notification channels remain valid regardless of whether prize collection requires a conditional claim.
Prize collection mode has no effect on the landing-page book-cover placement, size, crop, or visibility.
The confirmed claim flow does not change ticket issuance, counters, associations, resets, or accounting surfaces.
A provisioned wallet can still hold a prize after the winner initiates the required claim; wallet creation, custody, and access paths remain unchanged.
The message confirms how an eligible winner collects a prize but does not change the Small Block amount, trigger, eligibility window, ticket reset, or funding rules.
Prize collection mode does not change referral-code identity, lifetime, sharing methods, display surfaces, or resale behavior.
The conditional prize claim does not alter SIWE authentication or the dashboard access method for wallets created through Transak.
